- Tue Aug 24, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Aug 25, 13:00–14:00 PT
- Thu Aug 26, 08:00–09:00 PT

Please indicate your preferred slot and list any internal attendees we should include. If you need a different time zone, tell me and we’ll adjust.
